tasks.title: Academic Discussion
tasks.class: Reducing Carbon Emissions- Renewable Energy vs Building Efficiency
tasks.instruction:
Your professor is teaching a class. Write a post responding to the professor's question.
In your response, you should do the following:
• Express and support your personal opinion.
• Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Gupta
professor.text: Reducing carbon emissions is essential to slowing climate change. Two major strategies are often debated. One is investing in renewable energy sources like wind and solar to replace fossil fuels. Another is improving energy efficiency in buildings, such as using better insulation and appliances that use less electricity. Think about your own experience with energy use and the future you want to see. Which strategy do you believe is more effective? Explain your opinion using clear examples.

posts.name: Andrew
posts.text: Renewable energy is a more effective strategy because it replaces fossil fuels with clean sources like wind and solar. These technologies produce no carbon emissions during operation and can power entire communities. Their expansion supports long-term environmental goals and reduces dependence on nonrenewable resources that harm the atmosphere and climate.

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: I think improving energy efficiency is more effective. If we use appliances that need less energy and keep homes better insulated, we waste less power. This works right away and can be done by anyone. Wasting less electricity lowers emissions without needing large infrastructure changes.
